target_customer: Indian employers, landlords and consumers needing background and identity checks
problem: Background checks in India were manual, slow and costly. Helloverify automates identity, court record, education, credit and employment verification.
business_model: Per check fees from corporate and consumer customers

founders.name: Karan Mirchandani
education: Tufts University and London School of Economics, BA in Mathematics and Economics
founders.background_notes: Education from the YC founder profile on the company page; the only employer listed is Hello Verify, Inc.

founders.name: Varun Mirchandani
founders.background_notes: Listed as founder on the YC page and named in The NewsMinute (2019-03-12). No background found.

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating court, education and identity sources across fragmented Indian data systems requires many integrations and operations, though software itself is standard.

defensibility.rationale: Source integrations and corporate customer relationships help, but incumbents like AuthBridge existed and process can be copied.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows incumbents acquiring or copying Helloverify.

market_need_then: The YC description cites rising fraud rates and the need for credible background checks. The NewsMinute (2019) cites reports projecting the employment screening market at US$4.9 billion globally by 2023.

branding.domain_note: Company site is helloverify.ae (a .ae domain), and the .com was not confirmed.

identity.logo: Stylized H per a directory listing

brand_strength.rationale: A trademark for HELLO VERIFY was filed June 25, 2018 by Hello Verify, Inc., but no press about the brand itself was found.

outcome_analysis: Helloverify went through YC Winter 2018, announced an undisclosed seed in March 2019 from Lead Angels, YC, Data Collective and VentureSouq, and is still listed as active with a reported headcount of roughly 600. Funding totals conflict across aggregators, and no acquisition, layoff or shutdown reports were found, so the record shows a large services heavy screening business without public funding detail.
notes: The company site helloverify.ae returned 503 and could not be read. Seed round is stated by The NewsMinute (12 Mar 2019); Wamda reported VentureSouq participation (Mar 2019) but was not opened. PitchBook says $2.7M total raised while Inc42 lists $120K+; unverified and not recorded. Founding year conflicts (PitchBook 2012, GetLatka 2018), so founded_year is null. YourStory 2020 profile returned 403. Competitors: AuthBridge (founded 2005) and OnGrid (2016) were found only in sources dated 2021 or later, so the list is empty. Outcome search found nothing on shutdown or acquisition.
